description: From the bay, Baiona's town lights reflect in the moonlit water — the old town's glow spread along the shore with the castle-topped peninsula dark against the sky. The moon lays a silver path across the bay while the harbor lamps twinkle along the waterfront. Baiona is where the Pinta brought the news of the New World; tonight its bay lies peaceful under the moon.
